mapper.update: update cms_pm_plan set plan_nm = #{p.planNm}, tmpl_id = #{p.tmplId}, exec_mode = #{p.execMode}, cal_unit = #{p.calUnit}, cal_interval = #{p.calInterval}, schedule_basis = #{p.scheduleBasis}, anchor_date = #{p.anchorDate}, lead_days = #{p.leadDays}, assignee_id = #{p.assigneeId}, est_minutes = #{p.estMinutes}, next_due_date = #{p.nextDueDate}, usage_interval = #{p.usageInterval}, usage_lead = #{p.usageLead}, anchor_usage = #{p.anchorUsage}, next_due_usage = #{p.nextDueUsage}, use_yn = #{p.useYn}, remark = #{p.remark}, row_ver = row_ver + 1, updated_at = now(), updated_by = #{by} where plan_id = #{p.planId} and row_ver = #{p.rowVer}
mapper.select: select where p.use_yn = 'Y' and ((p.cycle_type = 'CAL' and p.next_due_date <= #{upTo} and not exists (select 1 from cms_chk_run r where r.plan_id = p.plan_id and r.due_date = p.next_due_date)) or (p.cycle_type = 'USAGE' and (select coalesce(sum(cr.delta_qty), 0) from cms_counter_reading cr where cr.counter_id = p.counter_id and cr.void_yn = 'N') >= p.next_due_usage - coalesce(p.usage_lead, 0))) and not exists (select 1 from cms_chk_run r where r.plan_id = p.plan_id and r.status = 'OPEN') order by p.plan_id
